title: Quick Energizing French Chicken Noodles
description: A malty and flaky French dish featuring chilli flakes and miso-marinate, perfect for a quick and energizing meal, this recipe is also egg-free-friendly and cooked in a wok.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the wok and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the wok and cook for 1 minute.
In a small bowl, whisk together the miso paste, malt syrup, and chilli flakes.
Pour the miso mixture over the chicken and garlic in the wok, stirring to combine.
Add the noodles to the wok and cook, stirring constantly, until they are well coated with the miso mixture.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Continue to cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove the wok from the heat and serve the Quick Energizing French Chicken Noodles hot.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
